brief:
Civilians pulled a girl from a flaming apartment after an Israeli attack struck a building in Gaza City, Al Jazeera English reported. Video footage showed residents rushing to extract the child from the burning structure as smoke and flames engulfed the upper floors.

The rescue occurred in a densely populated area where residential buildings frequently sustain damage during military operations in Gaza.
dek: Civilians rushed to rescue a girl trapped in a burning apartment after an Israeli attack struck a building in Gaza City.
title: Civilians rescue girl from burning Gaza apartment after Israeli strike
